summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Redemption for its US$2.5bn 2.251% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Senior Unsecured Notes due 2027 (CUSIP 404280CX5). The issuer elected to redeem the securities in whole at par (US$1,000 per US$1,000 principal) on 22 November 2026, with accrued interest from 22 May 2026 payable to holders of record as of 7 November 2026; because the redemption date falls on a non-business day, payment occurs 23 November 2026. This is an ordinary debt liability-management action, not a special situation. No premium, advisory, or regulatory-clock considerations apply; arbitrage attention is limited to routine redemption mechanics.
